definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating the point of departure for transportation.
Used to count gunshots, fireworks, or other projectiles fired.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}{発|はつ}の{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}る。
examples.english: To board a train departing from Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {10時|じゅうじ}{発|はつ}のバスはもう{出|で}ました。
examples.english: The 10 o'clock bus has already left.

examples.japanese: {2発|にはつ}の{銃声|じゅうせい}が{聞|き}こえた。

notes:
USAGE 1 - DEPARTURE:
・Place + {発|はつ} = departing from [place]
・Time + {発|はつ} = departing at [time]
・Often paired with {着|ちゃく} (arriving)

EXAMPLES:
・{東京|とうきょう}{発|はつ}{大阪|おおさか}{着|ちゃく} (departing Tokyo, arriving Osaka)
・{9時|くじ}{発|はつ} (departing at 9:00)

USAGE 2 - COUNTER:
・{一|いっ}{発|ぱつ} (1 shot)
・{二|に}{発|はつ} (2 shots)
・{花火|はなび}を{10発|じゅっぱつ}{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる (to launch 10 fireworks)

NOTE: As a counter, the reading changes: いっぱつ, にはつ, さんぱつ...
